rules.files: office-hours/SKILL.md plus every office-hours/sections/*.md (no .tmpl, no manifest.json)
rules.units: Logical lines. Outside fences, consecutive non-blank physical lines join while the previous line does not end in . ? ! : ; (optionally followed by closing quotes, brackets or emphasis) and the next line starts no list item (-, *, +, 1., 1), A)); a blockquote line never continues into a plain line. Blank lines, horizontal rules, headings, table rows and fences end a unit. Headings and table rows are their own units. YAML front matter and whole-line HTML comments are skipped.
rules.fences: Fences in /^(?:bash|sh|shell|zsh|console)$/i are skipped whole (commands, not instructions). In other fences only output-format lines count: /^#{1,6}\s+\S/ or /^(?:[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+(?:\s+[A-Z0-9<>_]+)*|[A-Z]<N>)(?:\s*\([^)]*\))?\s*(?::|\u2014)/.
rules.normalization: Strip blockquote, list and heading markers; curly quotes to straight; drop backticks; drop ** and __; drop single * or _ emphasis around words; collapse whitespace; trim. Case is kept.
rules.contract_line: A unit whose normalized text matches at least one category regex; every format line counts as output.

classes.kept: Exact normalized match in after SKILL.md (always loaded).
classes.moved: No exact match left in after SKILL.md, exact match in an after sections/*.md file (on-demand, except preamble.md which SKILL.md reads first).
classes.rewritten: No exact match anywhere in after; best similarity to any after unit >= 0.5.
classes.removed: No exact match and best similarity < 0.5.

rules.exact_pairing: Multiset match on normalized text: occurrences in the same file pair first, in line order; leftover before occurrences pair in order with leftover after occurrences, after SKILL.md first, then sections by name. A line that appears twice in before needs two copies in after to be matched twice.
rules.similarity: Sørensen-Dice over multisets of lowercase word tokens (split on characters outside [a-z0-9#<>/._'-], edge punctuation trimmed), stopwords removed: a an the and or of to in on for with by at as is are be been it its this that these those from into than then so if when while which who what your you we our their they them he she i me my his her there here will would can could should may might just also only any each. Negations are not stopwords. Ties prefer after SKILL.md, then the before line's own file.
rules.skill_rewrite: For a SKILL.md line classed moved: the closest after-SKILL.md unit that is new in after, when its similarity is >= the threshold. It marks a moved block whose shortened copy stayed in the always-loaded file.
rules.diet_change: true for rewritten and removed lines, and for lines that moved out of SKILL.md. false for kept lines and for lines that were already in a section and stayed there.
rules.load: SKILL.md is always loaded; sections/preamble.md is read first on every run (SKILL.md says so); other sections are read on demand.
